beginner.stem: Which history line belongs to Fermium?
options: Marguerite Perey, working at the Curie Institute, found a short-lived alkali metal among the decay products of actinium in 1939.
In December 1898, months after polonium, Marie and Pierre Curie announced a second, far more radioactive element in pitchblende.
André-Louis Debierne, a colleague of the Curies, found a new radioactive substance in pitchblende residues in 1899 and named it actinium, from the Greek aktis, a ray.

The same Mike debris held one more band.
